items.title: Meta spend 2026-10-16: $48.70, 1 lead, CPL $48.70
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign to spend: $48.70 CAD, 1,286 impressions, 28 clicks, 1 lead. CPL is about 2x the 7-day average ($23.20), but window spend is under the $50 flagging minimum, so no anomaly was raised.

needs_attention: No prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days; only yesterday (2026-10-16) was pulled, so earlier unreported days are not in this file (7-day baseline: $348.00, 15 leads, CPL $23.20).
